fusions.name: Spore-Tipped Stab
fusions.desc: A stab that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Fruiting Eruption
fusions.desc: Fungal spines burst from the ground around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leave each [Diseased] for 8 seconds. The disease is catching: it finds up to 2 more enemies within 5 tiles on its own, 30% of the time.

fusions.name: Bracket Shelf
fusions.desc: For 12 seconds, your armour rises by 20% and your poison resistance by 15%.

fusions.name: Mycelial Spear
fusions.desc: Conjures a spear of hardened fungus. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
